description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/VirtualAssistants/Login. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Signs in using the VA's own credentials; returns choices when several client relationships are active. ownerAgent: account-metrics. Use when: Open the separate VA login. Input: Email, Password, optional exact ProfileId after selection. Output: VA token plus effective permissions, or RequiresSelection and available profiles. Search terms: virtualassistants login. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true before execution.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.
